blind.second_guess: merchant counter with armor and iron goods
blind.description: A stylized wooden merchant shop counter with paneled sides and iron corner brackets. Arranged across the left side of the tabletop are various crafted metal items: a medieval closed helmet, stacked cast iron cooking pots with side handles, a couple of horseshoes, an axe head, a coil of iron chain or links, and a padlock. The surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with clean stylized painterly textures. Underside sits flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden slab with the right portion clear and the left portion occupied by a cluster of iron goods: a round pot opening, an iron helmet, horseshoes, an axe head, a coiled chain, and a small rectangular padlock.
blind.height_vs_figure: The counter stands at waist height (around half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure, roughly 3 ft tall), with items reaching slightly higher; the counter is about 4.5 to 5 feet long and roughly 2 feet deep.
